name: Nijigen Digital Comics Dorei Hime Lane
original_name: 二次元デジタルコミックス 奴隷姫レーン
source:
The kind-hearted Princess Lane is loved by all the people of her country. One day, while cross-examining a minister over a misdeed, she ends up in a worse dilemma! The minister has an evil plan...one which puts the princess' chastity in danger!!

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ033688.html/?locale=en_US]DLsite English[/url]]
